connections.why: The Wars of the Roses end with the Tudor accession, so the depth study sets up the breadth study chronologically
The post-war American Dream depth study sits within the long arc of the USA's rise to superpower status
The 1917 revolutions and Stalinist dictatorship are the pivotal core of the longer Russia breadth study
Both breadth studies trace a state's transformation into a 20th-century superpower
Both depth studies examine mid-20th-century societies that defined the Cold War rivalry
Both depth studies analyse how violent upheaval reshapes power and authority
The breadth study models the c.100-year sweep and interpretations skills the NEA requires
Long-span breadth study develops the change-over-time analysis central to the personal study
Depth-study source and interpretation work prepares the evidence handling the NEA demands
